meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 给 agent 容器的 Claude Code 装上 rtk 代理，并把 PreToolUse 钩子写进 settings.json，让每次 Bash 调用自动经 rtk 过滤。git、cargo、pytest 等开发命令的 token 消耗可省 60–90%，无需写 CLAUDE.md 指令。
howto.when: 当你想降低某个 agent group 容器里 Bash 命令的 token 消耗时，按此技能执行：宿主机装 rtk、挂载进容器、写入钩子，再重启容器生效。

say.note: rtk 会静默接管这次 Bash 调用

say.text: 用 rtk gain 看看省了多少 token

say.note: 确认 rtk 挂载是否生效

howto.what_en: Installs the rtk proxy and a PreToolUse hook so every Bash call in an agent container is silently filtered through rtk. Dev commands like git, cargo, or pytest use 60–90% fewer tokens, with no CLAUDE.md instructions.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to cut token usage of Bash tool calls in an agent group container: install rtk on the host, mount it into the container, add the hook, then restart.

say_en.note: rtk intercepts this Bash call silently

say_en.text: Check how many tokens rtk saved with rtk gain
